art.prompt: Premium editorial illustration for EvoRL, evolutionary search and reinforcement learning sharing a GPU simulation workflow. Landscape 16:9 at least 1600 pixels wide. A tabletop research landscape made of warm ivory sculpted terrain with five miniature articulated abstract mechanical leg models following different shallow paths. One central red track forms a subtle feedback loop connecting their paths around a charcoal circular platform. Focus on a population exploring different motion strategies and sharing a computational experiment, not a humanoid robot. Refined tactile plaster, anodized charcoal metal and restrained brand red; bright soft studio lighting, precise miniature craftsmanship, generous negative space, rich depth. No text, letters, logos, diagrams with data, fake UI, glowing chips or claimed results. Conceptual art, not experiment evidence.
